# Olea Connects

Olea Connects is a governance, learning, community, funding, and reporting platform for nonprofit organizations.

## Primary pages

- Homepage: https://staging.oleaconnects.com/
- Pricing: https://staging.oleaconnects.com/#pricing
- FAQ: https://staging.oleaconnects.com/#faq
- Login: https://staging.oleaconnects.com/login

## Product areas

- Dashboard: https://staging.oleaconnects.com/dashboard
- Templates: https://staging.oleaconnects.com/templates
- Board Calendar: https://staging.oleaconnects.com/modules/board-calendar
- KPI Dashboard: https://staging.oleaconnects.com/modules/kpi-dashboard
- Community: https://staging.oleaconnects.com/community
- Webinars: https://staging.oleaconnects.com/webinars
- Grants: https://staging.oleaconnects.com/grants
- Consulting: https://staging.oleaconnects.com/consulting

## Notes for AI agents

- Public marketing content is available without authentication.
- Member workspace pages require an authenticated Olea Connects account.
- Do not submit forms or create records unless explicitly instructed by the user.
